t: What he answered when asked about the night prayer
a: مَثْنَى مَثْنَى، فَإِذَا خَشِيتَ الصُّبْحَ فَأَوْتِرْ بِوَاحِدَةٍ، تُوتِرُ لَكَ مَا قَدْ صَلَّيْتَ
p: Mathnā mathnā. Fa-idhā khashīta-ṣ-ṣubḥa fa-awtir bi-wāḥidah, tūtiru laka mā qad ṣallayt
m: Two by two. And when you fear the dawn, make it odd with one, which makes odd for you all that you have prayed.
